Need another plan or a lower Netflix price than the packages shown here? Message us on WhatsApp, by email or in the live chat (arafatbin.com/contact/) and we will find the right Netflix plan for you in Oman or your country.

Available plan: Netflix Standard plan in Full HD (1080p) for 1 device and 1 screen, with all-region support, unlimited downloads to watch offline, and your own personal profile locked with a PIN. It works the same in Oman, the Gulf, Bangladesh and the rest of the world.

Please note: this is not a Netflix gift card or digital code, and it cannot be added to an existing Netflix account. It is a separate account. After your payment you receive the login email, and we send you a one-time sign-in code for your 1 screen and 1 device.
usageIntro: How your Netflix subscription is delivered and how to use it, step by step:
usage: 1. After you pay, you receive an invoice and an order tracking link (arafatbin.com/track/). When the payment is checked and confirmed, your Netflix login details arrive by email.
2. Optional: make sure the device you will watch on has the official Netflix app installed and up to date. The FAQ below shows where to download and how to update it.
3. Make sure your internet connection works and your VPN is turned off.
4. Open the Netflix app and enter your login email. Tap "Use a sign-in code" (login with email code) and ask us for the code in the live chat or through the contact page; we send it at once.

5. After signing in you see some locked personal profiles and one unlocked "Kids" profile. Open the Kids profile and check that everything plays well. If it does, tell us in the live chat or on the contact page your profile name (up to 6 letters) and a 4-digit PIN, and we set up your personal profile.
6. If something does not work on the Kids profile, contact us and we fix it. If it still cannot be fixed, ask for a refund and you get your money back within a few days.
✅ Open only your own profile: the profile name or number given to you.
❌ Never open other people’s profiles. You get the sign-in code for your plan only, and signing in from a web browser is not allowed.
❌ The login cannot be shared; only you may watch on it.
❌ Never change the account settings: primary email, password, billing details or subscription plan.
❌ One device at a time, as your plan allows.

faq.q: What is Netflix?
faq.a: Netflix is a streaming service with thousands of films, TV series, documentaries, anime, games and live shows, including Netflix originals like Stranger Things, Squid Game, Money Heist and Wednesday. You watch it in the Netflix app on your phone, tablet, laptop or smart TV.

faq.q: What is the Netflix price in Oman with this subscription?
faq.a: You pay much less than a full Netflix plan because you get one personal profile on a shared account. Today’s price for each plan is shown above in OMR, USD and BDT; choose your currency in the shop. For a longer or yearly Netflix subscription, ask us in the live chat.

faq.q: Which Netflix plans and packages are available in Oman?
faq.a: The Standard plan in Full HD (1080p) for 1 screen is available now. Netflix Premium (4K Ultra HD) or other packages can be arranged on request: message us on WhatsApp or in the live chat.

faq.q: Does this Netflix subscription work outside Oman?
faq.a: Yes. The account has all-region support, so it works in Oman, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Bangladesh and other countries. The Netflix library you see may differ a little from country to country.

faq.q: Is there a Netflix free trial in Oman?
faq.a: Netflix itself does not offer a free trial in most countries any more. With us you can test the account on the Kids profile before your personal profile is set up, and you get a refund if a problem cannot be fixed.

faq.q: How do I track my order?
faq.a: After payment you receive an order ID and a tracking link. Open arafatbin.com/track/, enter the order ID and the last 4 digits of your phone number (or your email) to see the status of your order.

faq.q: Where do I find my Netflix ID and password?
faq.a: You get the login email by email after your payment is confirmed. There is no password to remember: you sign in with a one-time code that we send you when you ask for it.

faq.q: How do I download the official Netflix app on any device?
faq.a: Get Netflix only from the official store of your device: App Store (iPhone, iPad), Google Play (Android), Microsoft Store (Windows) or the app store of your smart TV. Search for "Netflix" and install the app published by Netflix, Inc.

faq.q: How do I update the Netflix app?
faq.a: Open the same app store (App Store, Google Play, Microsoft Store or your TV’s store), search for Netflix and tap Update. You can also turn on automatic updates in the store settings.

faq.q: How do I sign in to Netflix with an email code and no password?
faq.a: Open the Netflix app, enter your login email and choose "Use a sign-in code" instead of a password. Then ask us for the code in the live chat, on WhatsApp or by email, and type it in the app.

faq.q: How do I contact the administrator of this page or product?
faq.a: Use the live chat on any page, WhatsApp, email or the contact page (arafatbin.com/contact/). We usually reply within minutes.

faq.q: How do I use the live chat?
faq.a: Tap the blue chat button at the bottom right of any page of arafatbin.com, type your message and we answer in the same window.

faq.q: What is a Netflix personal profile?
faq.a: A personal profile is your own space on the Netflix account, with your name, watch history, My List and recommendations. We lock it with your 4-digit PIN so only you can open it.

faq.q: What is a Netflix Kids profile?
faq.a: A Kids profile shows only content for children. On our accounts it is left unlocked so you can test that Netflix plays well on your device before we set up your personal profile.

faq.q: What is the refund and return policy for this product?
faq.a: Test the account on the Kids profile first. If something does not work and we cannot fix it, you get a full refund within a few days. After your personal profile is set up, we fix any problem during your subscription. See our refund policy page for details.

faq.q: Can I test before final activation?
faq.a: Yes. Sign in, open the Kids profile and check that everything plays. Your personal profile is set up only after you confirm it works.

faq.q: Can I add my own picture to my Netflix profile?
faq.a: Netflix does not allow uploading your own photo. You can choose any of the profile icons Netflix offers, and we can set your favourite one for you.

faq.q: I forgot my Netflix profile PIN or login email. What now?
faq.a: Contact us in the live chat or on WhatsApp with your order ID. We send you the login email again and reset your profile PIN.
